BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: undying
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: Death doesn't hold it. A few hours after it dies, it rises again, healed, unless its corpse has been destroyed or butchered first. It can only do this once every fifteen days.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: rises again after it is killed

BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: hydra-blooded
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: Cut it down and more grow back. When it dies, two young copies of it spring up beside the corpse, with every other trait it had.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: splits in two when it is cut down

BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: mirror-scaled
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: Polished, mirror-bright scales cover its body. A third of the shots that hit it glance off. Most fly off in a random direction and can strike anyone nearby. The rest fly straight back at the shooter.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: wears mirror-bright scales that turn bullets aside

BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: phasing
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: It slips through space when hurt. Each hit has a chance to make it blink up to 8 tiles away, at most once every 10 seconds.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: vanishes when struck and appears somewhere else

BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: pack-caller
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: When something attacks it, it calls out, and others of its kind within 35 tiles come to fight for it.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: calls its kind to fight beside it

BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: dread aura
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: An aura of dread surrounds it. Living enemies within 8 tiles are less aware and move more slowly. Mechanoids and entities don't feel it.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: fills the air around it with a dread that dulls the senses

BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: rallying
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: In a fight, its presence steadies its allies. Friendly people and animals within 7 tiles that it can see feel less pain and hit harder in melee.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: makes those who fight beside it fight harder

BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.label: elder
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.description: An ancient of its kind. It is bigger, tougher and stronger than any other, and its wounds close quickly.
BastleFramework.BastleTraitDef.rumor: is older and bigger than any other of its kind
